fields.finding: The lead also needs thin-gauge beryllium compression/fracture data, admissible in-plane honeycomb behavior, bonds, imperfections, joints and a realizable ribbon layout.
fields.consequence: Matching a steel/PVC hemisphere does not remove the lead's existing strength violations or establish its gamma.

claim: The lead also needs thin-gauge beryllium compression/fracture data, admissible in-plane honeycomb behavior, bonds, imperfections, joints and a realizable ribbon layout.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
